verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents scenario modeling that lets founders 'explore hypothetical future rounds' and 'model your next round, generate your term sheet', with exported scenarios and return calculations (IRR, cash-on-cash), so the core of priced-round modeling is claimed. The specific mechanics the story asks for are not evidenced, and sharing is described only as exporting 'to review with your team'. Missing for 10: explicit option pool top-up modeling, SAFE conversion modeling (only convertible note document generation is shown), pro-forma ownership/dilution output, in-platform scenario sharing with counsel and investors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
